purpose: Aggregate-only summary of a read-only lexical and panel-coverage scan of Microcosm's authenticated local mirror of the 2023 SIPP public-use person-month file; not a publisher statement, imputation, validity, universe or applicability decision
attribution: Microcosm-derived observation of the mirror's lexical encoding and record coverage. Publisher definitions are cited separately in sipp-source-documentation-20260905.json; this file does not restate them as publisher claims.

source.dataset: 2023 SIPP public-use person-month file (pu2023.csv), U.S. Census Bureau

panel.semantics: Record coverage only. Complete records are not evidence of complete reporting, residence duration or correct annual weighting.

lexical.semantics: A blank token is missing in the mirror; it is not a reported zero. Publisher and internal-file sentinel descriptions do not substitute for the mirror's actual encoding.

signed_fields.semantics: Repeated person-month source counts, not population estimates or annual incidence. Signed domains are documented in the dictionary excerpts.

findings.finding: 31 API dictionary labels are classified questionnaire_item_text without instrument verification. Preserve as API labels; a question-shaped description is not by itself authenticated questionnaire verbatim.
Prose calls TINC_RENT the only signed monetary input, but used TPTOTINC is also signed. Registry itself correctly preserves both ranges. Successor TPEARN is signed too.

field_contract_root_audit.scope: Root local verification of research evidence, no microdata reads or source implementation change

scope: Read-only source aggregates, no persisted keys/rows/values, no model/fit/calibration, no new source authority. Partial scans establish parser behavior only. Full twelve-month record coverage does not establish observation quality, residence duration or correct annual weighting.
checks: Mirror SHA-256 and inode, size and mtime unchanged before and after the scan
1,000-row smoke scan passed before the complete scan
All 265 registry fields present in the 5,200-column header
Entirely blank columns equal the set of fields the Census API labels Suppressed
Panel totals reconcile: month row counts sum to rows read; month-count distribution sums to unique person keys
limitations: Source auditing only; not a model, fit, calibration, certified source producer or new source authority
Does not convert any blank to a reported answer or decide source applicability from syntax alone
Annual recodes, monthly flows and end-period stocks retain separate period definitions not tested here
The remaining ten suppressed consumed fields were not individually checked in the dictionary PDF; whole-variable suppression is documented for TJB7_MSUM
No prior-wage feature, factor, imputation, target measurement or calibration is authorized by this evidence
